candidates.change_summary: Change the function to always return false at the end instead of true.
Change the function to return the success of the last external call instead of always true.
Relax validAddress to allow the zero address, changing which calls pass the modifier and thus affect return behavior.
Replace the internal low-level call target from msg.sender to address(this) so the called contract sees a different from-address, changing post-call observable state.
Change the loop to skip the first transfer (start index from 1), so fewer calls are made and state changes from those skipped calls are absent.
Relax validAddress to allow the zero address (remove the require that forbids address(0)), which can change behavior when transfer is called with contract_address == address(0).
